project_title: Plumb - AI Resume Analyzer (Awwwards-Level Cyber-Tech Web App)
design_archetype: Electric & Cyber Precision (Performance Pro + Futuristic Hud)
primary_language: JavaScript (React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion + R3F)

heading_font.usage: Main Hero Headings, Section Headers, Feature Titles, Numbered Manifesto Headings
heading_font.rules: Must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter). Never use Inter for headings.

technical_mono_font.usage: Data HUD readouts, ATS scores, code snippets, overlines, section numbers, marquee text, bullet comparisons
technical_mono_font.rules: Uppercase + wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-widest) for labels and section badges.

body_font.usage: Body paragraphs, form inputs, candidate resume text excerpts, modal text, feedback callouts
body_font.rules: Maintain high contrast against dark background. Use text-slate-300 or text-slate-200.

size_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none

primary_cyan.usage: Primary CTA glow, score gauge active arc, key metric highlighting, active state border

cyber_emerald.usage: Resume strengths, high match indicators, success toasts, verified ATS status

electric_violet.usage: AI intelligence badge, analysis engine live indicator, secondary accent gradients

warning_amber.usage: Resume weakness flags, missing key terms, moderate ATS score alert

danger_crimson.usage: Critical ATS dealbreakers, formatting errors, delete history button

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: Swiss Modular Grid + Bento Box HUD for Analysis Dashboard
layout_and_spacing.header_spec: Fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#07090E]/80 border-b border-cyan-500/20 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_spacing.mobile_rules: All bento grids drop to single column on small screens (grid-cols-1). Max image height max-h-[70vh].

motion_and_interactions.lenis_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling active globally for marketing sections
framer_motion_effects: Hero kinetic masked line-by-line text reveal on load
Interactive 3D rotating wireframe mesh/sphere with mouse reactive tilt
Staggered entrance for resume analysis metrics on upload
Real-time glowing scan line passing through uploaded resume text
Interactive gauge filling animation from 0 to actual ATS percentage
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: All action buttons must scale down slightly on click (whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}), feature glow on hover, and explicit text color shift on hover.
motion_and_interactions.hover_contrast_rule: Every hover state must explicitly define text color (e.g. hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black font-semibold).

3d_hero_strategy.type: Interactive Neural Network Mesh & Holo-Globe Sphere
3d_hero_strategy.library: @react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei (or Canvas HTML5 procedural fallback if WebGL contexts limit)
elements: Floating interactive particle constellation responding to pointer move
Cyan and Violet light sources creating holographic reflections
Dynamic scan plane passing through the 3D model
3d_hero_strategy.lighting: Ambient light intensity 0.6 + Point lights at [10, 10, 10] (Cyan #00F3FF) and [-10, -10, -10] (Violet #8B5CF6).

marketing_landing.hero_section: Kinetic text reveal + 3D interactive Canvas + Quick Try Resume Dropzone + live metrics pill

manifesto_chapters.title: PARSING THE UNSEEN
manifesto_chapters.description: Traditional ATS filters discard 74% of qualified candidates due to arbitrary keyword formatting flaws.

manifesto_chapters.title: NEURAL SEMANTIC MATCH
manifesto_chapters.description: Plumb's analysis engine evaluates experience depth, contextual achievements, and job description alignment.

manifesto_chapters.title: TACTICAL REWRITE ENGINE
manifesto_chapters.description: Instant actionable bullet upgrades calibrated to high-converting executive impact verbs.

marketing_landing.editorial_marquee: Slow drifting technical ribbon with specs: 'ATS OPTIMIZATION • PLUMB NEURAL REASONING • RECRUITER MATCH SCORE • TECH STACK AUDIT'
marketing_landing.feature_bento: Interactive interactive preview cards demonstrating real-time score updates, skill gap alerts, and salary benchmarks
marketing_landing.pricing_matrix: Transparent tier cards with glow borders and instant checkout modal triggers

app_dashboard.header_controls: Tab toggle between 'Upload & Analyze', 'Live History', and 'Target JD Matcher'
app_dashboard.upload_zone: Dual mode: Drag & drop PDF/DOCX simulated parser OR direct raw text terminal paste area
app_dashboard.target_jd_input: Optional Target Job Description box for tailored candidate-to-role match calculation

analysis_results_view.overall_score_gauge: Custom SVG circular gauge with glowing animated trail (e.g., 88% Strong Match)
analysis_results_view.sub_scores: Breakdown grids for Keyword Density, Impact Quantifiers, Executive Tone, Formatting Health
analysis_results_view.skills_cloud: Detected Tech & Soft Skills tagged with missing vs existing status pills
analysis_results_view.strengths_weaknesses: Accordion/Card list of strengths with green tick icons and weakness alerts with instant fixes
analysis_results_view.actionable_bullet_rewrites: Side-by-side 'Before vs After' bullet generator with 1-click 'Copy Improved Bullet' button

app_dashboard.analysis_history: Filterable history log of previous resumes scanned, scores, timestamp, and instant reload option

auth_system.features: Login & Register forms with toggle, quick 'Fill Demo Candidate' or 'Fill Demo Recruiter' buttons for fast evaluator testing, password visibility toggle, state persistence in localStorage, toast notifications via Sonner

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, upload zones, and cards include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='upload-resume-btn', data-testid='ats-score-gauge', data-testid='demo-login-btn').
2. Use Google Font imports for 'Space Grotesk' and 'JetBrains Mono' in index.html / index.css.
3. Build the 3D hero with @react-three/fiber if supported, or provide a robust responsive Canvas/WebGL animated node mesh fallback component so it runs seamlessly on all browser configurations.
4. Connect an AI API integration for resume parsing (or realistic mocked stream with instant actual evaluation when offline/unconfigured).
5. Include working sample resumes (e.g., Senior Full Stack Dev, Data Scientist, Product Manager) for quick 1-click test upload.

6. Do NOT use solid dark backgrounds without grid textures or subtle glow ambient radial blurs (e.g. bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-slate-900 via-[#07090E] to-black).
7. Include toast notifications via 'sonner' for resume scanning, copying rewritten bullets, and authenticating.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.accessibility: Contrast ratios > 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display headers. Focus outlines in vibrant cyan.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.contrast_verification: Ensure all text on dark slate surfaces uses text-slate-100 or text-cyan-400 for maximum readability.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.component_reuse: Utilize existing Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui (dialog, tabs, progress, dropdown, card, input) while replacing Vercel styling with cyber-tech borders and neon glows.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.toast_system: Use Sonner toasts from src/components/ui/sonner.js for system feedback.
